# Setup
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dpi = 300, collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", error = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(ggrepel)
library(pvclust)

basedir <- here("species/crob/bulk/ARCA123/KY21")
genomedir <- here("species/crob/genome/KY21")

source(here(basedir, "code/utilities_ggplot.R"), local = TRUE)
```

# Data

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

tpm <- read_csv(here(basedir, "data/03_compiled/tpm_no-testis.csv"))
metadata <- read_csv(here(basedir, "data/00_metadata/samples.csv"))

genes <- read_tsv(here(genomedir, "results/genes/gene-display-names.tsv"))
```

# Clustering

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6

pv <- tpm %>% 
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(), sqrt)) %>% 
  pvclust(method.hclust = "complete", 
          method.dist = "corr", 
          nboot = 1000, 
          parallel = TRUE)

plot(pv, print.num = FALSE, print.pv = "bp")
```

Comfortingly, all replicates cluster together. Interestingly, the intestine segments cluster by their colour. The two white segments (1 and 3) cluster together and the two yellow segments (2 and 4) cluster together, suggesting that their colours have a shared transcriptomic basis. 

# PCA

```{r}
pca_out <- tpm %>% 
  column_to_rownames("gene_id") %>% 
  sqrt() %>% 
  .[which(rowSums(.) > 0), ] %>% 
  t() %>% 
  prcomp(x = ., center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

pc_space <- pca_out$x %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("sample_name") %>% 
  right_join(y = metadata, by = "sample_name") %>% 
  mutate(tissue = factor(tissue, 
                         levels = c("stm.1.s", "int.1.w", "int.2.y", "int.3.w", "int.4.y")))

var_explained <- round(summary(pca_out)$`importance`["Proportion of Variance", ] * 100)

```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6

manual_colors <- c("wheat2", "snow2", "tan2", "snow2", "tan2")

ggplot(pc_space, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  geom_polygon(aes(fill = tissue), color = "black", linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = tissue), color = "black", size = 2.5, shape = 21) +
  geom_text(data = (pc_space %>% 
                      group_by(tissue) %>% 
                      summarize(PC1 = mean(PC1), PC2 = mean(PC2)) %>% 
                      ungroup()),
            aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = tissue)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = manual_colors) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", var_explained["PC1"], "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", var_explained["PC2"], "%)")) +
  theme_bw_2()

ggplot(pc_space, aes(PC1, PC3)) +
  geom_polygon(aes(fill = tissue), color = "black", linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = tissue), color = "black", size = 2.5, shape = 21) +
  geom_text(data = (pc_space %>% 
                      group_by(tissue) %>% 
                      summarize(PC1 = mean(PC1), PC3 = mean(PC3)) %>% 
                      ungroup()),
            aes(x = PC1, y = PC3, label = tissue)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = manual_colors) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", var_explained["PC1"], "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC3 (", var_explained["PC3"], "%)")) +
  theme_bw_2()
```
